newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh taka ends weaker, regains early loss.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh taka ends weaker, regains early loss.

text.p: The Bangladesh taka weakened slightly to close at 42.5480/5490 per dollar in active trade against the previous close of 42.5470/5490.
The local unit was quoted as low as 42.5480/5495 in early trade but edged up later as dollar supply rose, dealers said.
"There was demand from the market for the U.S. currency but ... state-owned banks had huge sell orders. Some foreign banks also sold later in the session," said one dealer.
Interbank call money rates finished flat at 4.5 percent to 5.5 percent, dealers said.
